name: Pukhlein
ingredients: Refined oil or mustard oil for deep frying
instructions: 1. In a pan, melt the jaggery in a small amount of water to create a thick syrup.
2. Gradually add the coarse rice flour to the jaggery syrup, stirring continuously to form a thick, stiff dough.
3. Allow the dough to cool slightly, then shape it into small, flat round discs.
4. Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan or wok.
5. Deep-fry the discs in the hot oil on medium heat until they turn a deep golden brown and become crispy.
6. Remove from the oil and drain on paper towels before serving.
description: Pukhlein is a popular sweet dish from the Khasi community of Meghalaya. It is often served during festivals, celebrations, and as a tea-time snack. Its simplicity highlights the staple use of rice in the region, transformed into a delicious, crunchy treat.
